idea-plugin.name: deja-vu: Cross-Agent AI Session Memory
idea-plugin.description:
Local cross-agent session recall, AI line blame, and handoff for IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, RustRover, CLion, PhpStorm, and Rider.

Reads the local deja SQLite FTS5 index across 43 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Junie, GitHub Copilot, Aider, Windsurf, and more) with secrets redacted before output and zero cloud dependencies.

  • Status Bar Widget: Live recall status for the open project; click to open the deja-vu action menu.
  • Search AI Sessions: Query past sessions across all agents on your machine and open transcripts in a read-only Markdown tab.
  • Recent AI Sessions: Browse the 50 most recent sessions across harnesses.
  • AI Blame Current Line: Find which AI coding session wrote or touched the file and line under the caret.
  • Copy Cross-Agent Handoff: Generate a compact handoff digest for the current project and copy it to the clipboard.

Requires the deja binary on your machine (brew install deja-vu or curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh).
